headline: Foreign Investors Pull ₹48,056 Crore From Indian Equities in October
summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew ₹48,056 crore from Indian equities in October, driven by high crude oil prices and global geopolitical tensions.
why: Foreign portfolio flows are a key driver of liquidity and valuations in emerging market equities like India.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Heavy foreign institutional outflows reduce demand for Indian equities, putting downward pressure on major indices.

why_moved: Substantial capital withdrawals by foreign institutional investors reduce aggregate buying pressure in the domestic stock market.
